guide.summary: Linear documents user-level OAuth2 for apps connecting individual accounts. The authorization-code flow redirects the user to Linear with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, state and scope, then exchanges the code at the token endpoint. Access tokens expire after 24 hours and are refreshed with a refresh token. The default read scope, always present, is the least-privilege grant for reading issue titles. Pagination uses GraphQL first/after cursors. Creating, updating or deleting issues is out of scope; issues:create and write scopes are not used. Setup, app registration and customer distribution remain unverified.

steps.title: Read the first page of issue titles
steps.detail: Call the GraphQL API with the Bearer access token and request the first 10 issues' titles with pageInfo. The response body's data.issues.nodes array delivers the title property of each issue; pageInfo.endCursor and hasNextPage come from the same issues object.
steps.doneWhen: The response contains data.issues.nodes with title values and a pageInfo object with hasNextPage and endCursor. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

evidence.quote: ```graphql query Issues {
} cursor } pageInfo {
``` Or pass the token as an authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`

request.example: curl 'https://api.linear.app/graphql' '-X' 'POST' '-H' 'Content-Type: application/json' '-H' 'Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN' '--data' '{"query":"query { issues(first: 10) { nodes { id title } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }"}'

fields: ACCESS_TOKEN: from exchange-authorization-code response access_token
issues.nodes.title: issue title property
pageInfo.endCursor: cursor for the next page

steps.title: Continue reading issue titles until hasNextPage is false
steps.detail: Repeat the same query with after set to the previous pageInfo.endCursor, keeping first 10, until pageInfo.hasNextPage returns false. Stop only then; a single page is not a full listing. Use the endCursor from the previous response as the after argument, preserving first 10, and repeat until pageInfo.hasNextPage is false.
steps.doneWhen: Requests continue with each endCursor until hasNextPage is false. hasNextPage returns false on the final page. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.

fields: PREVIOUS_END_CURSOR: pageInfo.endCursor from the prior response
